title: Await PixiJS application initialization
why: Application.init is asynchronous in PixiJS v8; using the application before completion can race renderer setup.
suggestion: Await app.init(options) before accessing the canvas, renderer, stage, or ticker.
limitations: PixiJS v8 migration checks require an explicit version 8 pixi.js or @pixi dependency in package.json.
Ticker ownership is resolved only for direct receiver.ticker.add/remove calls and inline frame callbacks.
